criteria.title: Derive the persistence order: invalidate the old marker and flush, write complete after-images and flush, then publish and flush the new commit marker.
criteria.task: Enumerate persistence cuts around old-marker invalidation/flush,all after-image writes/flush and new-marker write/flush. Derive why each surviving authoritative marker implies complete required data under the declared model.
criteria.purpose: Write order in source implies persistence order without barriers.
